name: Nakagawa (Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Nakagawa town emblem in white: a ring open at the top and bottom enclosing three upward strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Nakagawa, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 May 1964.

features.role: Nakagawa town emblem — a ring open at the top and bottom enclosing three upward strokes
